events.headline: UN AGENCY PAUSES HORMUZ SHIP EVACUATION INITIATIVE AFTER VESSEL ATTACKED
events.detail: Iran warns vessels to use only Tehran-approved routes as IMO halts Hormuz evacuation after ship struck.

events.headline: NACIONES UNIDAS SUSPENDE SU PLAN PARA EVACUAR MARINEROS DE ORMUZ TRAS UN ATAQUE
events.detail: El barco, que no formaba parte del plan internacional de evacuación, ha sido alcanzado por un proyectil en aguas de Omán

events.headline: UN PAUSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ EVACUATION PLAN AFTER CARGO SHIP ATTACKED
events.detail: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

events.headline: KRIEG: FOR IRAN CONTROL OF THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ IS ABOUT THE SPOILS OF WAR
events.detail: Andreas Krieg said Iran possesses sufficient geographic and military leverage in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: RUBIO: GULF COUNTRIES DON’T SUPPORT STRAIT OF HORMUZ TOLLS
events.detail: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said all Gulf countries oppose a toll in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: OIL PRICE FALLS BACK TO PRE-IRAN WAR LEVELS
events.detail: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.
